shortDescription: The International Monetary Fund is considering adding pandemic preparedness reforms to its financing program for the Democratic Republic of Congo as the country’s worsening Ebola epidemic exposes weaknesses in how it funds and responds to health emergencies, according to Bloomberg.

title: GEOPOLITICS | IMF Considers Pandemic Preparedness Reforms for Congo as Ebola Spreads
